project.name: distrib
project.description: Kura is a Java/OSGI-based framework for IoT gateways. Kura APIs offer access to the underlying hardware (serial ports, GPS, watchdog, I2C, etc.), management of network configurations, communications with M2M/IoT Integration Platforms, and gateway management.
